verdict.gold_reason: Article 41(1)-(2) of Regulation 2017/2195 sets the market-based allocation process for contracting up to one week ahead and limits allocated capacity to 10% of the previous calendar year's available capacity for energy exchange, or 10% of installed technical capacity for new interconnectors. The reference answer matches this.
verdict.ambiguity_reason: The question is obfuscated but maps to the market-based process in Article 41. The reference omits that the limit may not apply when contracting is at most two days ahead, or for DC interconnectors. Article 42's 5% applies to contracting more than a week ahead, so it does not conflict.
